hardEffects.name: Illusion
hardEffects.note: onBeforeSwitchIn picks the last non-fainted party member after its own slot (not Ogerpon/Terapagos once terastallized); disguise shows in switch/details lines; ends on damaging hit with `replace` + `-end`; Illusion Level Mod changes details (sim/pokemon.ts getDetails).

hardEffects.name: Imposter
hardEffects.note: On switch-in transforms into the foe in the mirrored slot (`foe.active[len-1-position]`), i.e. full Pokemon.transformInto semantics at switch-in time.

hardEffects.name: Transform
hardEffects.note: Pokemon.transformInto: copies species, types, stored stats (not HP), boosts, moves at 5 PP, ability, crit volatiles; many fail cases; Ogerpon/Terapagos targets block later Tera.

hardEffects.name: Trace
hardEffects.note: Seeks on start; onUpdate samples (PRNG sample) one adjacent foe whose ability lacks notrace; keeps seeking until a valid foe appears.

hardEffects.name: Dancer
hardEffects.note: Engine special case (sim/battle-actions.ts useMoveInner): after a successful dance move every other active Dancer re-runs it, sorted by storedStats.spe ascending (ties: most recent ability first), with special target rules.

hardEffects.name: Instruct
hardEffects.note: Re-queues the target's lastMove at lastMoveTargetLoc via queue.prioritizeAction; long fail list (charge/recharge/failinstruct/Beak Blast/Focus Punch/Shell Trap/0 PP).

hardEffects.name: Magic Bounce
hardEffects.note: Bounces reflectable moves (onTryHit) and side-targeted ones for the ally side (onAllyTryHitSide) by calling useMove with a fresh ActiveMove marked hasBounced.

hardEffects.name: Protect
hardEffects.note: onPrepareHit requires queue.willAct() and a successful StallMove event; adds stall volatile; protect condition blocks protect-flagged moves (breaksProtect / Feint / unprotectable exceptions).

hardEffects.name: stall
hardEffects.note: Consecutive Protect: StallMove does randomChance(1, counter); counter starts 3 and triples on restart up to counterMax 729; duration 2.

hardEffects.name: Wide Guard
hardEffects.note: Side condition for one turn blocking allAdjacent/allAdjacentFoes moves; consumes the stall counter (onHitSide adds stall); cancels a fresh lockedmove.

hardEffects.name: Burning Bulwark
hardEffects.note: Protect variant (like Spiky Shield / Baneful Bunker): blocks like Protect, burns contact attackers (checkMoveMakesContact) from the condition onTryHit; a smartTarget move is silently retargeted (no -activate); cancels a fresh lockedmove; the Z/Max onHit branch is dead in Gen 9.

hardEffects.name: Follow Me
hardEffects.note: Doubles redirection: volatile with onFoeRedirectTarget (priority 1) returning the user if validTarget; clears smartTarget; fails when activePerHalf is 1.

hardEffects.name: Storm Drain
hardEffects.note: onAnyRedirectTarget for single-target Water moves (randomNormal/adjacentFoe normalised to normal), clears smartTarget; absorbs with +1 SpA or immunity message.

hardEffects.name: Dragon Darts
hardEffects.note: smartTarget two-hit move: hits each foe once in doubles, or retargets the second hit when the first target is invalid/immune/protected (engine smartTarget logic).

hardEffects.name: Population Bomb
hardEffects.note: multihit 10 with multiaccuracy: accuracy rolled per hit (stops on miss); Loaded Dice changes hit count/accuracy handling; Skill Link; Technician.

hardEffects.name: Substitute
hardEffects.note: User pays 1/4 HP; substitute condition intercepts damage in onTryPrimaryHit (own damage calc, recoil and drain applied there, -activate [damage]); bypasssub/infiltrates skip it; removes partial trapping on start.

hardEffects.name: Shed Tail
hardEffects.note: Pays ceil(maxhp/2) via directDamage, creates a Substitute and selfSwitch "shedtail" so only the substitute is passed; fails if cannot switch or Commander.

hardEffects.name: Baton Pass
hardEffects.note: selfSwitch "copyvolatile": replacement inherits boosts and copyable volatiles (noCopy excluded); fails if no switch target.

hardEffects.name: Parting Shot
hardEffects.note: Drops Atk/SpA then selfSwitch only if a boost actually happened (or target has Mirror Armor); switch request in the middle of the turn.

hardEffects.name: Dragon Tail
hardEffects.note: forceSwitch: target is dragged out and replaced by getRandomSwitchable (PRNG sample) at the end of the move; fails silently on various conditions.

hardEffects.name: Revival Blessing
hardEffects.note: Adds revivalblessing slot condition + selfSwitch so the player must pick a fainted party member to revive mid-turn (special request); interacts with doubles slot occupancy.

hardEffects.name: Trick
hardEffects.note: takeItem on both sides plus TakeItem singleEvents for permission; Sticky Hold immunity; restores items on failure; swapped items run their Start handlers.

hardEffects.name: Knock Off
hardEffects.note: 1.5x power only if the TakeItem singleEvent allows removal (plates/masks/Rusted items/Booster Energy on Paradox are fixed); removal in onAfterHit, not through substitute.

hardEffects.name: Magician
hardEffects.note: After its move, speedSorts move.hitTargets (PRNG on speed ties) and steals the first takeable item.

hardEffects.name: Tera Blast
hardEffects.note: Type = teraType when terastallized; Physical if boosted Atk > SpA; Stellar: 100 BP and self -1 Atk/-1 SpA; Stellar damage rules in the engine.

hardEffects.name: Tera Starstorm
hardEffects.note: For Terapagos-Stellar: type Stellar, target becomes allAdjacentFoes, Physical if terastallized and Atk > SpA.

hardEffects.name: Tera Shift
hardEffects.note: onSwitchIn (priority 2): Terapagos permanently becomes Terapagos-Terastal (ability -> Tera Shell via formeChange isPermanent).

hardEffects.name: Tera Shell
hardEffects.note: At full HP every damaging hit is not very effective (checked per target / per hit, including spread moves).

hardEffects.name: Teraform Zero
hardEffects.note: When Terapagos becomes Stellar (engine terastallize -> Terapagos-Stellar), clears weather and terrain.

hardEffects.name: Embody Aspect (Teal)
hardEffects.note: Ogerpon Tera formes (engine terastallize -> Ogerpon-*-Tera, permanent formeChange with source=null) get Embody Aspect: one stat +1 once per battle on start.

hardEffects.name: Shell Side Arm
hardEffects.note: Chooses Physical vs Special by comparing two simplified damage formulas; calls randomChance(1, 2) only when they are equal; physical version makes contact.

hardEffects.name: Protosynthesis
hardEffects.note: On start/weather change adds/removes protosynthesis volatile; condition picks bestStat (getBestStat(false, true)), 5325/4096 boost (1.5x Spe); Booster Energy variant persists without sun.

hardEffects.name: Quark Drive
hardEffects.note: Electric Terrain twin of Protosynthesis (quarkdrive volatile, bestStat, Booster Energy).

hardEffects.name: Booster Energy
hardEffects.note: onStart/onUpdate: if Protosynthesis/Quark Drive without sun/terrain, useItem then addVolatile; cannot be removed from Paradox Pokemon.

hardEffects.name: Disguise
hardEffects.note: Mimikyu: onDamage -> 0 and busted; onCriticalHit false and onEffectiveness 0 tricks; onUpdate permanent formeChange to Mimikyu-Busted then 1/8 damage whose effect is a Species object.

hardEffects.name: Ice Face
hardEffects.note: Eiscue blocks one physical hit (busted -> Eiscue-Noice in onUpdate), restored on snow at start/weather change; crit/effectiveness tricks like Disguise.

hardEffects.name: Shields Down
hardEffects.note: Minior: Meteor forme above 50% HP, Core (set.species) at or below, checked on start and residual; Meteor is status- and Yawn-immune.

hardEffects.name: Hunger Switch
hardEffects.note: Morpeko alternates Full Belly/Hangry at residual (order 29) unless terastallized; Aura Wheel type follows.

hardEffects.name: Gulp Missile
hardEffects.note: Surf loads Gulping (>50% HP) or Gorging forme; when hit: 1/4 attacker max HP damage plus Def -1 or paralysis, then reverts.

hardEffects.name: Zero to Hero
hardEffects.note: Palafin becomes Palafin-Hero permanently on switch-out; activation message on the next switch-in.

hardEffects.name: Relic Song
hardEffects.note: onAfterMoveSecondarySelf toggles Meloetta Aria/Pirouette (non-permanent formeChange); spread move with 10% sleep.

hardEffects.name: confusion
hardEffects.note: Duration random(2, 6) (random(3, 6) from Axe Kick); each BeforeMove decrements, prints -activate, randomChance(33, 100) self-hit for getConfusionDamage(40) with pseudo-move {id: "confused"}.

hardEffects.name: slp
hardEffects.note: Duration random(2, 5); Early Bird double decrement; sleepUsable moves still run; Sleep Clause Mod (onSetStatus) and Rest (fixed 3) interplay.

hardEffects.name: frz
hardEffects.note: BeforeMove randomChance(1, 5) thaw; defrost moves and thawsTarget/Fire hits thaw; Shaymin-Sky reverts to Shaymin permanently (ability becomes Natural Cure).

hardEffects.name: partiallytrapped
hardEffects.note: durationCallback random(5, 7) (Grip Claw 8); residual 1/8 (Binding Band 1/6) while the source stays active; traps.

hardEffects.name: lockedmove
hardEffects.note: Rampage lock: trueDuration random(2, 4); ends with confusion (fatigue) unless interrupted; sleep releases without confusion.

hardEffects.name: twoturnmove
hardEffects.note: Charge turn: stores move id, adds a volatile named after the move, remembers target location (random foe if called move), runs PrepareHit, locks the move.

hardEffects.name: Electro Shot
hardEffects.note: Charge move: +1 SpA on the charge turn, skips charging in rain (effectiveWeather), ChargeMove event (Power Herb), else twoturnmove.

hardEffects.name: choicelock
hardEffects.note: Locks to the first move used while holding a Choice item (not bounced/Snatch); disables other moves; removed when item is not a choice item.

hardEffects.name: SunnyDay
hardEffects.note: Weather: 5 turns via durationCallback (Heat Rock not in scope); onWeatherModifyDamage Fire 1.5x / Water 0.5x keyed on the defender's effectiveWeather(); frz immunity; field residual (order 1) prints the upkeep line then runs eachEvent("Weather"); drives Protosynthesis, Orichalcum Pulse, Chlorophyll, Solar Beam, Harvest.

hardEffects.name: Psychic Terrain
hardEffects.note: Terrain: blocks priority moves against grounded targets (including the ally side in doubles), 1.3x Psychic for grounded users; Expanding Force spread conversion.

hardEffects.name: Trick Room
hardEffects.note: Pseudo-weather (5 turns) that reverses speed ordering in the action queue; using it again ends it.

hardEffects.name: Aurora Veil
hardEffects.note: Only in snow; screen modifier 2732/4096 in doubles (0.5 singles), not vs crits/infiltrator; Light Clay 8 turns.

hardEffects.name: Helping Hand
hardEffects.note: Priority +5 ally move; 1.5x base power multiplier that multiplies again if used twice; fails if the ally already moved.

hardEffects.name: Pollen Puff
hardEffects.note: Against an ally: base power 0 and heals 50% instead of damaging; blocked by Heal Block on the user.

hardEffects.name: Encore
hardEffects.note: Locks the target into its last move for 3 turns (+1 if it has not moved yet); onOverrideAction rewrites an already-queued action.

hardEffects.name: Sucker Punch
hardEffects.note: Fails unless the target's queued action is a non-status move (queue.willMove lookahead).

hardEffects.name: White Herb
hardEffects.note: Restores negative boosts; re-checked on AnySwitchIn, AnyAfterMove and residual (order 29); boosts captured in effectState for onUse; Fling effect.

hardEffects.name: Intimidate
hardEffects.note: On start lowers each adjacent foe's Atk in order (substitute -> -immune); boost runs TryBoost/AfterBoost (Mirror Armor, Clear Body, Defiant, Competitive, Rattled...).

hardEffects.name: Natural Cure
hardEffects.note: Cures on switch-out; doubles onCheckShow logic decides whether the cure is revealed in the protocol.

hardEffects.name: Beads of Ruin
hardEffects.note: Ruin abilities: onAny modifier tracked per move (move.ruinedSpD) so only one holder applies; holders of the same ability are exempt.

hardEffects.name: Mold Breaker
hardEffects.note: Sets move.ignoreAbility so breakable abilities are suppressed for the duration of the move (also Turboblaze/Teravolt/Mycelium Might).

hardEffects.name: Protean
hardEffects.note: Before the move (onPrepareHit), once per switch-in, changes type to the move type; excluded for bounced/future/called moves.

hardEffects.name: Curse
hardEffects.note: Ghost vs non-Ghost behaviour decided at onModifyMove/onTryHit (target rewritten, volatileStatus/onHit deleted for non-Ghosts); Ghost curse costs 1/2 HP and deals 1/4 per turn.

hardEffects.name: Heal Block
hardEffects.note: Psychic Noise heal block (2 turns via durationCallback): disables heal-flagged moves, blocks healing (onTryHeal), special Pollen Puff handling.

hardEffects.name: Rusted Sword
hardEffects.note: With the zacian species condition: at BattleStart Zacian becomes Zacian-Crowned (setSpecies, ability reset) and Iron Head becomes Behemoth Blade; item cannot be removed.
